card.name: Just before the word political
card.fires_on: Words or word parts right before "political" or "politics", such as "and" after "civil", "-pol" in "non-political" or "socio-political", and "geo" or "socio" prefixes.

modes.label: Civil and political
modes.description: The word "and" after "civil" where "political rights" comes next.
modes.example: 1966 International Covenant on Civil<< and>> Political Rights

modes.label: Inside compounds
modes.description: The partial piece of a compound such as non-political, socio-political or geopolitical, just before "itical".

modes.label: Prefixes before politics
modes.description: A prefix like micro or soci that leads into a politics or sociopolitical word.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce "political" or "politics" next, in several languages.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "political", such as in "civil and political rights" or "socio-political".
